rows.definition: The pure per-turn function that scores the three context-acquisition strategies (prefix reuse, session-index query, cold prefill) by their token tax and returns the single cheapest AVAILABLE one together with the reason it won.
rows.distinction: PlanTurnTax CHOOSES BETWEEN per-turn strategies; ProbePlan is one of the options it chooses among (ProbePlan plans the spans a single O(1) index query would retrieve). PlanTurnTax retrieves nothing itself. It is also not turntaxmeter, which MEASURES per-rung overhead after a run rather than deciding before a turn.

rows.definition: The recorded outcome of one PlanTurnTax call: the strategy chosen for a turn, the operator-readable reason it was chosen, and the three per-strategy token taxes plus availability flags the choice was made from.
rows.distinction: TurnTaxDecision records WHICH context-acquisition strategy a whole turn took and what it cost in tokens; PageFaultDecision records how ONE missing context item is admitted or refused. A turn produces exactly one TurnTaxDecision and any number of PageFaultDecisions.
